description: AICTIONBOT™ Skonto-Radar by KULIC Advisory. Takes an open-items list (invoices with discount terms) and optional clarification cases from other checks, and returns which discounts expire within the window, which are blocked by a payment hold or an open clarification, which are already lost, and the last payment run that still catches each one. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Findings are written in German. Keys may be given in German (beleg, lieferant, bestellung, rechnungsdatum, eingang, betrag, skonto_pct, skonto_tage, netto_tage, skonto_bis, faellig, sperre) or English (document, supplier, order, invoice_date, received, amount, discount_percent, discount_days, net_days, discount_until, due, blocked).

clarifications.description: Optional open clarification cases from other checks: document, order, reason (grund), with (bei), result (ergebnis).

open_items.description: Open invoices. Each item: document, supplier, order, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY), received, amount (negative for credit notes), discount_percent, discount_days, net_days, discount_until, due, blocked (yes/no).

payment_run_weekdays.description: Weekdays of the payment runs, 1 = Monday. Default [2, 5] (Tuesday, Friday).

window_days.description: Days ahead that count as 'expiring soon'. Default 10.

name: check_discount_window
title: Find early-payment discounts (Skonto) that expire in the next days, and which payment run still catches them
